title: Sign in and reach the protected dashboard
description: An unauthenticated visitor can sign in with Google and reach the authenticated dashboard shell.

steps.description: Verify the secure landing screen is displayed
Click the sign in with Google control
Verify the authenticated dashboard is displayed

title: Add a new income transaction
description: An authenticated user can create an income transaction and see it appear in the transaction list.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Choose income as the transaction type
Fill in a valid amount into the amount field
Fill in a unique title into the title field
Fill in a valid date into the date field
Select a category for the transaction
Verify the new transaction appears in the transaction list
